decisions.limitation: Improvement narrows at higher depths  (weakness of: DenseRet: Learning Dual-Encoder Representations for Open-Domain Passage Retrieval)
decisions.evidence: Increasing retrieval depth helps direct questions but gives diminishing returns on multi-hop questions when relevant passages are not jointly selected.

decisions.limitation: Requires fixed input length  (weakness of: DenseRet: Learning Dual-Encoder Representations for Open-Domain Passage Retrieval)
decisions.evidence: The question, a compact separator, and the selected passages are concatenated into the input of a Seq2Seq Generator.

decisions.limitation: Does not leverage prior work  (weakness of: DenseRet: Learning Dual-Encoder Representations for Open-Domain Passage Retrieval)
decisions.evidence: RetGen combines retrieval and generation for Open-domain QA. It first uses DenseRet to retrieve passages.
